 Order

The petitions have been filed under Section 438 Cr.P.C. by the petitioners seeking anticipatory bail in case FIR No. 214/2023 under Sections 498A/406/304-B/34 IPC registered at Police Station Bawana, Delhi.

2. In brief the facts of the cases are that an information was received vide DD No.58A dated 01.02.2023 regarding suicide by a lady, and during enquiry it was revealed that one lady, namely,
Priyanka was found lying dead on the 1st Floor of her house and piece of chunni was knotted in her neck and other piece of chunni was knotted to the ceiling fan of the room.
The husband of the deceased was present at the spot and he stated that her wife allegedly committed suicide by hanging herself to the ceiling fan.
It was further revealed that the marriage of the deceased was solemnized within two years, and this fact was informed to the SDM and proceedings under Section 176 Cr.P.C were initiated.

The statement of the brother of the deceased was recorded by the SDM on 02.02.2023, in which he stated that her sister was tortured by the mother-in-law and the husband on the pretext of demanding dowry.

He further stated that in February 2022 deceased Priyanka gave birth to a male child and on the function of Kua Pujan of the child, her in-laws and her sisters-in-laws (present petitioners) taunted Priyanka by saying that "tune aaj hamari samaj me naak katwa di" and all of them showed their desire for gold articles for each of them.

He further alleged that her sister came home around one and a half months before the incident and she stated that all of her jewellery is kept by her mother-in-law and she doesn't even allow her to wear the jewellery.

He further alleged that on 14.12.2022 when husband of the deceased went to his in-laws house to bring back his wife, she refused to go with him by saying that her in-laws tortured her for demand of dowry.
He further alleged that on 31.12.2022 Priyanka told telephonically that her husband, and her in-laws are now demanding Rs.10 lacs in cash.
He further alleged that her sister has been murdered by her in-laws in a very planned manner.

3. It is submitted by the learned senior counsel for the petitioners that the present three petitioners are married sister-in-laws, and are living separately from the matrimonial house of the deceased.
He further submitted that as per the allegations in the FIR, the only alleged demand of gold chain of 2  Tolas was made on 28.02.2022 at the time when the deceased had given birth to her son.
He further submitted that except this alleged allegation there are no other allegations against the petitioners.

It is further submitted by the learned senior counsel for the petitioners that death has taken place on 01.02.2023 and there is no alive and proximate link between the alleged demand made by the petitioners and the act of suicide.

He further submitted that the mother-in-law has Ritu vs State (Govt. Of Nct Of Delhi) on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/47966569/
2 already been admitted to regular bail, and all the petitioners are having minor children.
4. On the other hand, learned APP has vehemently opposed the bail application of the petitioners and has argued on the lines of the status report.
5. I have also perused the status report.
6. In the instant cases, the only allegations against the petitioners are of demanding 2  Tolas gold chain from the deceased at the time when she gave birth to the child and it was way back on 28.02.2022, and the death has taken place on 01.02.2023 almost after one year of the alleged demand.

7. In these facts and circumstances, in the event of arrest, petitioners be released on bail on their furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- each with one surety in the like amount each to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer/SHO concerned.

8. The applications stand disposed of accordingly.
9. Nothing stated hereinabove shall tantamount to the expression of any opinion on the merits of the case.

10. Dasti.
RAJNISH BHATNAGAR, J APRIL 21, 2023/
